title: SMSF Borrowing Limits Property: LRBA Rules & Caps
description: SMSF borrowing limits for property explained: LVR caps, limited recourse rules, bare trust setup, and what lenders approve in 2025.
takeaways: SMSFs can only borrow through limited recourse arrangements
Funding improvements with the loan can breach LRBA rules
Members cannot rent the fund’s residential property
